title: Talk to Ava about the Cradle

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Would you like me to search the Cradle on the networks?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would you like me to search the Cradle on the networks?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, please.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Searching… No active records found under that name. However, I have located fragmented data from seventy-one years ago. A project labeled “Cradle.”

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Searching… No active records found under that name. However, I have located fragmented data from seventy-one years ago. A project labeled “Cradle.”

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What kind of project?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Unknown. All associated records have been expunged.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unknown. All associated records have been expunged.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Expunged?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: More thorough than deletion. The data wasn’t just removed—it was deliberately erased from multiple archives. Someone wanted it gone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: More thorough than deletion. The data wasn’t just removed—it was deliberately erased from multiple archives. Someone wanted it gone.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can you recover anything?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I can attempt deeper retrieval, but if this was a targeted wipe, results are unlikely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can attempt deeper retrieval, but if this was a targeted wipe, results are unlikely.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Try anyway.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Understood. However, please be advised—searching for erased data often attracts attention.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Understood. However, please be advised—searching for erased data often attracts attention.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: From who?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: That is an excellent question. Shall we find out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That is an excellent question. Shall we find out?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Deeper retrieval initiated… I have something. Partial data fragments, buried in an obsolete server cluster.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Deeper retrieval initiated… I have something. Partial data fragments, buried in an obsolete server cluster.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do they say?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The Cradle some kind of facility—specifically, a nursery.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Cradle some kind of facility—specifically, a nursery.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A nursery?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Clones. The data is heavily corrupted, but I’ve reconstructed enough to determine that high-ranking members of Curzona were conducting experimental cloning.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Clones. The data is heavily corrupted, but I’ve reconstructed enough to determine that high-ranking members of Curzona were conducting experimental cloning.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Clones of who?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Curzona executives. It appears they were creating… successors. Copies of themselves, grown from infancy, presumably to be trained into leadership roles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Curzona executives. It appears they were creating… successors. Copies of themselves, grown from infancy, presumably to be trained into leadership roles.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That’s insane. Did it work?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Unclear. The project was abruptly terminated decades ago. All records purged. The facility itself appears to be... no longer present in the city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unclear. The project was abruptly terminated decades ago. All records purged. The facility itself appears to be... no longer present in the city.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: No blueprints, no decommission reports, no structural remnants. It was there… and then it wasn’t.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No blueprints, no decommission reports, no structural remnants. It was there… and then it wasn’t.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It must have been a horrific place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It must have been a horrific place.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It must have been a horrific place.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It must have been a horrific place.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Bad enough to have it removed from Nivalis' history entirely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bad enough to have it removed from Nivalis' history entirely.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: But considering the extent of this cover-up… perhaps you should ask a different question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But considering the extent of this cover-up… perhaps you should ask a different question.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: …Which is?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Are they still out there?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Genius! Did it work?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who? Where? About what? And why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who? Where? About what? And why?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Who? Where? About what? And why?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Who? Where? About what? And why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So nothing is left?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Just kidding, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What did they nurse there that they wanted to erase?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did they nurse there that they wanted to erase?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What did they nurse there that they wanted to erase?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What did they nurse there that they wanted to erase?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What the hell happened there?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like deleted?
